hits.snippet: # G2 To Buy Capterra, Software Advice, And GetApp From Gartner By Amit Chowdhry ● Jan 30, 2026 G2 announced it has formally agreed to acquire Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from Gartner, a deal that would combine four major B2B software review and discovery platforms under one owner as software buying increasingly shifts toward AI-driven search and recommendation experiences. The company said the combination is intended to deepen the data foundation behind software discovery, evaluation, and purchasing by bringing together the properties’ audiences and review datasets. G2 said the combined platforms would encompass about 6 million verified customer reviews, reach more than 200 million annual software buyers globally across the properties, serve more than 10,000 software vendors with marketing solutions, and span roughly 2,000 software and service categories. G2 said it plans to integrate data and offerings from Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp into its platform, including expanded first- and second-party buyer-intent data.
